# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report a vulnerability privately, through this repository's security advisories:
<https://github.com/clunny/clm/security/advisories/new>.

Never report one in a public issue or pull request.

## Supported version

The latest release is the supported version. A fix ships in a new release.

## Scope

In scope:

- the `clm` binary,
- the Claude Code plugin (`plugin/` and `plugin-panel/`),
- the web app (`web/`).
